mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.0% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate decline below 7.0% fails to generate positive 5-day returns in over 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) declines while housing starts (HOUST) rise, it indicates supply constraints easing into demand-driven growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of INDPRO decline and HOUST rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Early-cycle GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals robust economic expansion that increases corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 2.5% fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of early-cycle instances.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained job growth (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 135,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising above 235.0 signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 235.0 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate falls while real sales (RSAFS) rise, it indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS decline and RSAFS rise fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 99.0) in late-cycle context reduces corporate output growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 99.0 fails to generate negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
